messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — I'm PTO Sat/Sun (02:00 UTC Sun push). Need someone to hold the deployer rights and be ready to rollback if the canary flaps. Can we grant a short-lived deployer for the window?
Sam: I can cover the window. Prefer JIT grant for 4h. Will run canary and stop if errors.
Tanvi: I can be backup. Ping me if Sam needs help.
Lee: Quick Q — are we pinning the image digest and model hash for the canary or using latest? We should pin both.
Maria: I'll create rollback tag and a mini-runbook in release-notes now.
deploy-bot: Automated check: current deployers = Olivia, ops-service-account. No active temporary grants. Audit will record any /grant-deployer actions. Use `/grant-deployer <user> <duration>` to request.
Sam: /grant-deployer @Sam 4h — requesting approval from @sec-team and @Olivia for the weekend window.
sec-team: Approve on emergency basis only. Conditions: MFA enforced, session TTL=4h, require runbook link in thread.
Olivia: Approved. Maria's runbook link please.
Maria: Runbook: https://intranet/release/1.12.0-canary. Steps + health checks + rollback commands added.
ops-bot: Action: creating JIT grant request id=gj-174529. Notifying sec-team.
deploy-bot: Grant issued: /grant-deployer @Sam expiry=4h by sec-team. Session token id=tok-9f3b. Audit: https://audit/logs/gj-174529
Sam: starting canary push now — will stream logs.
deploy-bot: Deploy started job=deploy-174529-1 service=inference action=canary percent=10 logs=https://logs/174529/1
Sam: canary at 10% healthy. bumping to 50%.
Sam: observation: KV cache hit rate dropped ~18% on tail requests, causing p95 spike +10%. Keeping canary at 50% while I investigate.
Maria: prep rollback tag v1.11.9-rollback and DB-metrics dashboard pinned.
Sam: decision: rolling back to v1.11.9-rollback due to continued p95 degradation and error budget risk.
Sam: executing rollback now: ```sh
redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to-tag v1.11.9-rollback --reason "kv-cache regression"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started job=rollback-174529-2
deploy-bot: Rollback complete job=rollback-174529-2 status=success. All services back to v1.11.9-rollback.
ops-bot: Monitoring: health checks green, error rate returned to baseline.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll paste a short postmortem + artifact diffs in the release thread later today.
Olivia: Appreciate the cover. Will review notes when back. :thumbsup: 
Tanvi: Good call — nice runbook + quick rollback.
Maria: I've uploaded the rollback artifact and added a short checklist for future canaries.
sec-team: Confirming audit: grant tok-9f3b used by Sam for deploy and rollback; no policy violations. Closing temporary grant.
Sam: /revoke-deployer @Sam - done.
deploy-bot: Grant revocation confirmed. session tok-9f3b invalidated.
